Rewrote `mergeRanges` in `ranges.mjs`:

- Validates input is an array; each element must be a 2-element array of safe integers with `start <= end`, else `TypeError`.
- Copies pairs into fresh arrays before sorting (by start, then end), so the input array and its pairs are never mutated.
- Merges when `start <= last[1] + 1` (overlap or adjacent integers), and only extends the end when the new end is larger, so contained intervals can't shorten the current interval.
- Returns fresh pair arrays in a fresh result array; empty input yields `[]`. Named export kept.

No tests were run (no execution tool available); correctness was checked by reading the code.
